signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {A : Type u_1} -> {B : Type u_2} -> {C : Type u_3} -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring A] -> [Star A] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring B] -> [Star B] -> [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring C] -> [Star C] -> (f : B →⋆ₙ+* C) -> (g : A →⋆ₙ+* B) -> A →⋆ₙ+* C

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: This is a total construction; any two non-unital ⋆-ring homomorphisms with matching intermediate type yield a valid composite, with no junk-value or edge conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∃ (f : ℤ →⋆ₙ+* ℤ) (g : ℤ →⋆ₙ+* ℤ), (VTask.comp f g : ℤ →⋆ₙ+* ℤ).toFun ≠ (VTask.comp g f : ℤ →⋆ₙ+* ℤ).toFun
